qa.q: When do traffic jams usually happen?
qa.a: I mean, the simple answer is when there are too many cars on the roads, or at least too many cars for the roads to cope with. But it could also be down to poor infrastructure planning. So, engineers haven't arranged for enough space on the roads in certain areas, which causes bottlenecks. That could be a hassle.
